# gen/go (generated, do not edit)

Go types for the Affogato contracts in `proto/affogato/*/v1`, module
`github.com/affogato/affogato/gen/go`.

The `*.pb.go` files are generated by `buf generate` (`protoc-gen-go`, `paths=source_relative`,
pinned in `buf.gen.yaml`). Do not edit them by hand: change the `.proto` files and regenerate with

```sh
make contracts-gen
```

`go.mod`/`go.sum` are the only hand-maintained files; keep `google.golang.org/protobuf` at the
pinned plugin version.

```go
import eventsv1 "github.com/affogato/affogato/gen/go/affogato/events/v1"
```
